name: CoorAngle
formula: =LAMBDA(h,b,tf,tw,[isRepeatFirstPoint],LET(isRepeat, IF(ISOMITTED(isRepeatFirstPoint), FALSE, TRUE), xa, b, ya, h, xb, b, yb, h - tf, xc, tw, yc, h - tf, xd, tw, yd, 0, xe, 0, ye, 0, xf, 0, yf, h, rowA, HSTACK(xa, ya), rowB, HSTACK(xb, yb), rowC, HSTACK(xc, yc), rowD, HSTACK(xd, yd), rowE, HSTACK(xe, ye), rowF, HSTACK(xf, yf), output, IF(isRepeat, VSTACK(rowF, rowE, rowD, rowC, rowB, rowA, rowF), VSTACK(rowF, rowE, rowD, rowC, rowB, rowA)), output))
comment: Create coordinates of vertices for a I Section. isRepeatFirstPoint = FALSE by default. Last Update at 2024-07-02.
